tasks.detail: Start backend (http://localhost:5000) and frontend (http://localhost:5173) together. First run: run.bat once, or the Setup + Migrate task, so the database and backend/.env exist.
tasks.label: Run Everything (VS Code, no Docker)

tasks.command: cd backend; if (-not (Test-Path .env)) { Copy-Item .env.example .env; Write-Host 'backend/.env was created from .env.example - open it and set your PostgreSQL password in DATABASE_URL, then run this task again.'; exit 1 }; $line = Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^DATABASE_URL=' }; $env:DATABASE_URL = ($line -replace '^DATABASE_URL=','').Trim(); if (-not $env:DATABASE_URL) { Write-Host 'DATABASE_URL is empty in backend/.env - set it first (see SIMPLE_START.md).'; exit 1 }; psql ($env:DATABASE_URL -replace '/exam_management$','/postgres') -c 'CREATE DATABASE exam_management' 2>$null; psql $env:DATABASE_URL -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f ..\database\migrations\001_init.sql
tasks.detail: Reads DATABASE_URL from backend/.env (copy backend/.env.example to backend/.env and set your PostgreSQL password first), then creates the database tables (schema only, no sample accounts). Needs PostgreSQL running.
tasks.label: Setup + Migrate

tasks.command: cd backend; if (-not (Test-Path node_modules)) { npm install }; npm start
tasks.detail: Install backend packages if needed, then start the API on http://localhost:5000
tasks.label: Start Backend

tasks.command: cd frontend; if (-not (Test-Path node_modules)) { npm install }; npm run dev
tasks.detail: Install frontend packages if needed, then start the website on http://localhost:5173
tasks.label: Start Frontend

tasks.detail: Start the whole system with Docker: database + backend + frontend. Then open http://localhost:8080
tasks.label: Start All (Docker)
